--8<-- [start:regex_auto_binding]
# What you write:
match(r"(?P<YEAR>\d{4})-(?P<MONTH>\d{2})", S)

# What the compiler sees (after expansion):
match(r"(?P<YEAR>\d{4})-(?P<MONTH>\d{2})", S, _G),
YEAR is _G["YEAR"], MONTH is _G["MONTH"]
--8<-- [end:regex_auto_binding]
